title: Cross-Desk Note with the Trade-Up Desk on a Closure Sum Taken Back Out of a Credit
content:
# Cross-Desk Note with the Trade-Up Desk on a Closure Sum Taken Back Out of a Credit

30 per cent of the sum reached on a closure, 12 per cent of it, or nothing of it is taken back out of an upgrade credit on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions. Which of the three follows turns on the credit the customer still holds and on whether the chain sold the piece that registration was traded against.

## The shares

1. Where the customer holds an upgrade registration standing part spent with credit still available and the chain sold the piece that registration was traded against, 30 per cent of the sum reached is taken back out of that credit.
2. Where the customer holds an upgrade registration standing part spent with credit still available and the chain did not sell the piece traded against it, 12 per cent of the sum reached is taken back out of that credit.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken back out of an upgrade credit.

## Where the records are

The credit still available on an upgrade registration standing part spent, and the till transaction the traded piece was originally sold on, are held under Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes. The chain sold the piece traded against the registration where that till transaction stands on the registration, and did not where it is empty.

## Readings (hypothetical)

On a sum reached of USD 5000.00:

- An upgrade registration standing part spent, credit still available USD 1200.00, the till transaction of the traded piece standing on it: USD 1500.00 is taken back out of the credit.
- The same registration with no till transaction standing on it: USD 600.00 is taken back out of the credit.
- No upgrade registration standing part spent, or no credit still available on it: nothing is taken back out of an upgrade credit.
